title: The Winter Atlas
author: Wren Voss
blurb: Oscar Zhou, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
